title: Among male patients diagnosed with SLE who have normal white blood cell cou
question: Among male patients diagnosed with SLE who have normal white blood cell counts and whose laboratory test was conducted after their first hospital visit, identify the patient with the highest total cholesterol. Return their ID, sex, age at the time of the lab test, and total cholesterol level.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    p."XCL_058",
    p."XCL_059",
    l."XCL_016",
    l."XCL_026"
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l
  ON p."XCL_058" = l."XCL_014"
WHERE p."XCL_059" = 'M'
  AND p."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
  AND l."XCL_030" BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0
  AND l."XCL_015" > p."XCL_062"
ORDER BY l."XCL_026" DESC
LIMIT 1

LIMIT 1
